scientific_role: development-only clarification of how public occurrence rows become population anchors and how the frozen CIR04 Myoko slot is localized; no structural outcome has been scored under the underspecified implementation
problem_fixed: raw historical GBIF rows must not be treated as independent population anchors
species-wide Cirsium otayae anchors from the Northern Alps or Hakusan must not silently expand the frozen Myoko slot
later public clusters outside the historical Myoko slot catchment must not enter the local-slot recovery denominator

generic_anchor_representation.historical_cluster_rule: deterministic complete-link greedy clusters with maximum within-cluster distance 0.5 km
generic_anchor_representation.anchor_rule: one deterministic medoid per historical cluster
generic_anchor_representation.medoid_objective: member minimizing the sum of haversine distances to all members of its cluster

public_reference.name: Mount Myoko / Myokosan elevation point
public_reference.source: Japan Meteorological Agency Myokosan volcano page

cir04_myoko_slot.historical_slot_selection: select exactly the four historical cluster medoids with the smallest haversine distance to the frozen public Myoko reference; tie-break by medoid latitude, longitude and gbif_key
cir04_myoko_slot.recent_slot_attribution: assign each 2021-2025 complete-link cluster to the historical cluster with minimum cluster-to-cluster distance; tie-break by the historical medoid stable order; a later cluster belongs to the CIR04 slot only when its nearest historical cluster is one of the four selected Myoko anchors
cir04_myoko_slot.reobservation_rule: later cluster at <=0.5 km from its nearest historical cluster is a reobservation and is excluded from the novel-cluster denominator

execution_boundary.candidate_frames: unchanged 0.5-2.0 km primary and 0.5-5.0 km sensitivity annuli around the selected cluster medoids

forbidden: do not replace the four anchors after structural results
do not change the Myoko reference after structural results
do not expand the slot with later occurrence coordinates
do not relabel this development smoke as prospective confirmation
